prompt: This is a search-autocomplete service. Every time a user runs a search, `recordQuery()` walks an in-memory prefix Trie, bumps the frequency on the matching node, and then persists the whole thing. It works fine in the demo, but once the dictionary grows into the millions of terms, the service crawls and Redis memory explodes. Walk me through the code below, tell me exactly why this happens, and describe how you'd fix the persistence and memory behavior — without hurting `getSuggestions` latency, which still needs to stay fast.
